sentences.japanese: 一人一人が戸口を掃けば、町はきれいになる。
sentences.english: If each would sweep before the door, we should have a clean city.

sentences.japanese: お前は床を掃きさえすればよい。
sentences.english: You have only to sweep the floor.

sentences.japanese: 彼女はいつも床を綺麗に掃いています。
sentences.english: She always sweeps the floor clean.

sentences.japanese: 台所をきれいに掃くのを忘れないように。
sentences.english: Don't forget to sweep the kitchen clean.

sentences.japanese: 私は枯葉を掃き集めた。
